About this product

The dense dual-sided microfibre pulls water from paint with fewer passes.

The manageable size reduces contact with paint and helps prevent streaks.

How to use it

1) Wash the vehicle using a pH-safe shampoo such as Origin Shampoo.
2) Rinse thoroughly.
3) Lay the towel flat and gently drag or pat dry.
4) Wring out only when completely saturated.

Tech Specs

• GSM: 1200GSM (dual-sided plush microfibre)
• Size: 90 × 60 cm
• Material: Premium dual-sided microfibre
• Edge: Soft microfibre edging
• Suitable for: Cars, SUVs, vans, paintwork, glass and exterior plastics
• Best use: Post-wash drying, especially on larger or heavily rinsed vehicles
• Wash: Machine washable on a cold, gentle cycle with microfibre or non-bio detergent
• Care: Do not use fabric softener or bleach
• Dry: Air dry only, do not tumble dry

FAQ’s

Will this towel scratch my paint?

No, not when used correctly. Only use it on clean, shampooed paint.

Is it too heavy when it’s wet?

It feels heavier when fully loaded with water, which is the trade-off for extra absorbency.
